schemes.meaning: Standard FP/Hodge bookkeeping leaves a scalar half-determinant in Gamma unless zero/gauge/Jacobian normalization cancels it explicitly.

schemes.formula: Gamma_scalar_residual -> kappa_Cas branch only, no P02 trace-square
schemes.meaning: This is the needed isolation lemma, not a consequence of the bare covariant FP determinant.

obligations.test: Show zero/gauge/Jacobian factors cancel the -1/2 log det' Delta0 residual in the same normalization, or keep it.
Compute delta_g^2 log det' Delta0 under first ambient strain and project to Sym^2(R4)=P02.
Prove the retained scalar branch contributes only kappa_Cas=1/24 and no finite P02 trace-square.

verdict: Bare standard covariant FP/Hodge bookkeeping gives Gamma = 1/2 log det' Delta_1,coex - 1/2 log det' Delta0, so exact/scalar cancellation is not zero by default. If that residual scalar half-determinant carries the same P02 trace-square, the desired rank-10 suppression is reduced to an effective rank 5 in the simplified sign model. Therefore C6 requires an additional cancellation or selection lemma: either work in the physical transverse quotient as the defining scheme, or prove that the standard-FP scalar residual is only the kappa_Cas=1/24 branch and has no P02 leakage.
